verdict.rationale: GitCafe's repository rulesets can protect matching branches by requiring pull requests, reviews and passing checks. They can also enforce CODEOWNERS approval for each changed path, and an Evaluate mode lets you trial the rules as warnings first. Buildkite results show up as checks on pull requests, so automated CI can gate merges into protected branches. Missing for 10: deployment- or environment-level approval gates beyond branch merge protection, detail on how required checks are configured and enforced, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rulesets.
